# @tansy/theme-blog

A blog look for tansy: a header with a menu, posts on the home page, post pages and plain pages.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-blog
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the themes guide](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/guides/themes.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
